title: Warp knitting machines for Heimtextil guests
content: **Obertshausen, Germany– 13 December, 2024 –** Heimtextil will take place in Frankfurt am Main from January 14 to 17, 2025, and KARL MAYER is taking advantage of the proximity of its headquarters to the Main metropolis to invite its customers visiting the trade fair to a machine presentation in Obertshausen. The focus of the product show will be on tricot machines, which are among the most successful in the product portfolio of the world market leader and cover a wide range of applications. A highly efficient Raschel machine for the production of sacks will also be on show at KARL MAYER. A TM 4 EL, also with a 210" working width and in E 28, completes the range of efficient machines on display. An HKS 2-SE PLUS, 130", in E 40, will also be demonstrating its skills in the production of special elastic warp knitted fabrics for swimwear, sportswear and lingerie.
